=== Lead photograph (31 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of the man on the near side of a Facebook photograph posted 12 November 2019. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group (facebook.com/bruce.savin.7). Rogue 9 Gloucester, United Kingdom. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Bruce Savin portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Bruce Savin Facebook portrait.jpg]].
